uncertaintyLabelProtocol.principle: No finite-underprecision geometry is promoted to an exact target. Existing independent original-method blocks are converted to an explicit noisy observation or the geometry is refused.

uncertaintyLabelProtocol.spectralShapeRule: A spectral/PCA target may enter only when its blockwise mean and SEM are recoverable under the same eligible-block identity. Otherwise spectral shape at that evidence point is not admitted and support must tighten or fail closed.
uncertaintyLabelProtocol.failureConsequence: LOCAL_OOD_OR_UNSUPPORTED; never silently drop uncertainty and never substitute another estimator result

prefitModelProcedureBoundary.allowedCandidateFamilySource: Only already-versioned families/representations in review/core-training-surrogate-model-freeze-v1/protocol-v1.json or a strictly simpler subset; no new family invented after seeing fit/benchmark outcomes.
